title: On semi-openness of fiber-onto extensions of minimal semiflows and quasi-separable maps
summary: The purpose of this paper is to find conditions for a continuous onto map $φ\colon X\rightarrow Y$ and its induced map $φ_*\colon\mathcal{M}^1(X)\rightarrow\mathcal{M}^1(Y)$ to be semi-open, where $X$, $Y$ are compact Hausdorff spaces and $\mathcal{M}^1(X)$, $\mathcal{M}^1(Y)$ are their Borel probability spaces. For that, we mainly prove the following results by using the structure theory of extensions of semiflows and inverse limit techniques: (1) If $φ$ is an extension of minimal flows, then $φ_*$ is semi-open.
